chapter: Harlem musicians and the road with Armstrong
title: Sidemen who never became names, like Doc Cheatham
summary: Many fine musicians, such as trumpeter Doc Cheatham, worked their whole lives as sidemen without becoming known.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Were there any other drummers at the time that you thought were very good?

Oh yeah, a lot of drummers around. Big Sid... Oh, a lot of drummers around. Some of them made a big name, some of them didn't. But all of them made a living. Some of them didn't care to make big names. That's just not...not only drummers. I mean, any instrument you can name. They had all kind of instruments in New York City, and players and one-thing-or-another. Everybody didn't get a big break, or this-that-and-the-other.

Now, there's a man today like...name... Because you'd know him. But he's been around here for years, too. He's never been a big name on his own, but today he is. And this goes from way back. A marvelous trumpet player, one of the best in the business. And he just worked from this place to that place, to this band, the other band, the best of jobs, the best of bands or the worst of bands -- it didn't make no difference. It was work. And that's Doc Cheatham. Do you understand what I mean? He was always a sideman, or working for somebody else. He was never up-front as a leader,

trying to get it on his own.
That's why some people that you've never even heard of, they be in the business fifty or sixty years, and they work all the time -- nobody ever hears of them. They don't try to front anything on their own, but they're working all the time with the best attractions, and so forth and so on. And they are good musicians. Doc is one of the best trumpet players in the business, and he works with the best... You name anything and he can play it. I mean, any kind of music, any kind of show. He does the job.

And there's a lot of musicians around just like Doc. I wouldn't say they're as capable as he is, not trumpet players... But there's a lot of good trumpet players, too, in his classification. Nobody ever hears of 'em. Some of them work all the time, just go around mindin' their business, doin' the work, getting the money...
